{{Top|leg}}
A '''Song of Swarming''' was [[Music/Legends|music]] created by the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] which was used to summon more of the Kind when they moved to claim more territory. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Daria Thul]] became a [[Joiner]] and warned a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] representative to depart the mines as her Killik nest had sung a Song of Swarming which meant that they were claiming the area as part of their territory.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
